hypothesis: M193 shows that the refreshed M192 current-family boundary surface can be converted into replay-aligned objective corpora. A tiny anchored actor update from the current-best M189 checkpoint may improve the M193 M189 objective without washing out behavior, protected key, or old/new proof-surface replay gates.
success_criteria: use the M193 M189 boundary-outcome corpus as training-time objective data only
use a strong action anchor and small update count
improve the fixed M193 M189 objective on held-out seeds or fixed eval
preserve M168/M170 M183 replay gates and M193 refreshed replay gates
failure_criteria: run PPO before a low-drift actor update passes gates
ignore old M183 replay surfaces while optimizing the new M193 corpus
accept objective improvement without behavior and replay retention
